hypotheses.name: Shop or event collection account
hypotheses.summary: An account collecting from several customers and settling onward can look like fan-in followed by fan-out.
hypotheses.check: Established merchant history and consistent payout counterparties before this window.

hypotheses.name: Group or wedding pool
hypotheses.summary: A one-off pooled collection by an organiser, paid out soon after, fits the same timing.
hypotheses.check: Payers overlap an existing contact group and the pool is a one-off with a known organiser.

hypotheses.name: Refund burst
hypotheses.summary: Rapid outbound transfers to prior counterparties can be refunds rather than onward movement.
hypotheses.check: Outbound transfers match earlier purchases from the same counterparties.
